track_note: track W only — the D-track's absence is a declared decision (prereg §2), not an omission
engine_frozen: engine/top_anatomy.py is byte-frozen at main for this wave; the arms are its existing extended_mask(variant=...) masks
tier: research/display tier, zero scored authority; AVOID-not-SHORT; no rank, no size, no gate, no exit rule

panel.panel_cache_sharing_basis: panel content is upstream of every EXT mask — split repair reads raw prints, identity segmentation reads tape gaps and repaired-close up-ratios, and no panel leg is a function of an extension definition

prefix_parity_gate.note: the §3 repair gate is a PANEL property; its internal episode anchor uses the primary variant, so this receipt is about the repair, not about the arm

episode_census.definition: DISJOINT = the episode's arm EXT-day set shares ZERO (segment, session) days with the phase-0 primary EXT-day set

coverage_gate.vintage_date_source: derived from the panel's last session, never a manifest

mcap.note: the reference carries a large-cap index roster only, so the uncovered remainder of the roster is not 'unknown mcap' at random — it is everything outside that index

feature_panel.arm_keying_basis: the F family (F1_episode_age / F2_drawdown_in_episode / F5_reclaim_speed) is anchored on `episodes`, which come from this arm's EXT mask — feature values are NOT EXT-definition-independent, so this panel is built per arm and never shared with the phase-0 pass

matching.bin_edges: quintile/tercile edges cut WITHIN CALENDAR QUARTER over this panel's own case+control union (prereg §2: bins are population-relative)

e1.peak_month_floor_verdict: 48 distinct episode-peak months vs the 12 required — floor MET

confirmatory.test: one-sided in the declared direction, from the same episode-peak-month block bootstrap; BH-FDR over exactly these 5 tests
confirmatory.one_sided_derivation: One-sided p in the DECLARED direction, read off the same block-bootstrap draws.

exploratory.bh_family: letter family, within the 31 exploratory features only

FULL.survivor_definition: confirmatory legs clearing the one-sided q on this panel, plus exploratory features flagged separating — descriptive readouts only

e1b.population: all resolved EXT days (TOPPED or CONTINUED)
e1b.nested: M0 (r126) subset M1 (+rv63) subset M2 (+the other 35)
e1b.preprocessing: median-impute + standardize, fit on TRAIN folds only
